items.title: Mike Vax interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2022
items.q: when Stan was sick that first time in 1971 and he was gone for five months, Dick Shearer and I led the band and Dick led the music and conducted and I did all of the announcing

ctx.x: What did your band manager duties entail? Were you in charge of booking motel rooms and all that kind of thing?

Yeah. Yeah I had to book all the hotels. I had to collect all the money. I had to stay in touch with Harold Plant’s office, that was the people that handled all of Stan’s finances and money and stuff. If we were getting paid in cash you had to take it — there were a couple of different banks that we used where Stan had accounts and you’d have to take it. It was really funny because sometimes we’d be out for seven or eight, nine days without getting to a bank or anything and I’d have a whole bunch of cash with me…

be able to re-join the band but the doctors want him to stay a little longer. Well it was all lies because you know we had to keep the band on the road for him. So I had to pretend that, oh gee I really did think Stan was going to be joining us but they just said at the last minute he can’t. So then they would, a lot of times, especially clubs and things like that, they’d try to say well you broke the contract because Stan isn’t here. And I’d say, “You sold out, we’re trying to keep this band on the road for Stan…
